mechanics.claim: The fireball applies on-hit effects and triggers on-attack effects.
mechanics.quote: applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects; applies {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness; and triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Any applied Dragon Practice (stack-based bonus) damage uses the same modifiers as Q but does not get life steal.
mechanics.quote: Any applied ''{{ai|Dragon Practice|Smolder}}'' damage is affected by the same damage modifiers as ''Super Scorcher Breath'' and does not benefit from the ability's {{sti|life steal}}.

mechanics.claim: Tier 1 explosion also applies on-hit and life steal at 50% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: The explosion benefits from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Tier 2 bolts also apply on-hit and life steal at 50% effectiveness.
mechanics.quote: The bolts benefit from {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} at 50% effectiveness and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.

mechanics.claim: Subsequent burn applications stack damage but do not refresh duration.
mechanics.quote: Subsequent applications of the burn stack, though not refreshing the duration of the previous burn.

mechanics.claim: Only Smolder's own damage counts toward triggering the tier 3 execute, and a killing blow that would drop below threshold executes on that same instance.
mechanics.quote: Only '''Smolder's''' damage counts for triggering the execute. ... If ''Super Scorcher Breath'' would damage the target to below the execution threshold, they are executed on the same damage instance.

mechanics.claim: Q can only hit each enemy once per cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Super Scorcher Breath'' can only hit enemies once per cast.

mechanics.claim: Minion/monster damage modifier only applies to the physical damage component (not the true damage burn).
mechanics.quote: The minion and monster damage modifier applies only to the physical damage.
